GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Ecosystems? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Ecosystems.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Ecosystems.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Ecosystems.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Ecosystems.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic Spectrum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cell division and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and Biodiversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Skeletal and Muscular System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
